_comment: Grid B for the HERMES COMPARISON (v0.2.4): (z, pT2), per pi0, the HERMES bin edges of arXiv:0704.3270 Table A.1: z = 0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.9, 1.3 and pT2 = 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1, 1.4, 1.95, 5 GeV2. Their cut z > 0.2 is the edge 0.2. The top z edge is theirs (1.3); the RG-D z window (cuts.json, z < 1) still applies, so the last bin holds 0.9 < z < 1. Pairs with z < 0.1 or pT2 > 5 GeV2 are off this grid. Used only by run_hermes_chain.sh / hermes_ra.py.

provenance.source: manual: HERMES z and pT2 edges, arXiv:0704.3270 Table A.1
